 "rationale": "GBW≈gm1/(2πCL) requires gm1≥1.76 mS, so the design targets about 2.3 mS at ~175 µA. The f3db spec needs gds_total≥82 µS. A 16 k resistor to VDD carries about 30% of Id1. It sets gain near 23 dB and widens bandwidth. It also lowers the sensitivity of the output DC level to current mismatch. The PMOS mirror supplies the remaining 70%. Total current is about 240 µA, or 430 µW. Low-vdsat devices allow a swing of about 0.3 to 1.5 V."}

PARAMS = {
    "L1":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),      # input NMOS length
    "I1":    (175e-6, 120e-6, 220e-6),  # M1 drain current at vin=VIN_DC
    "frac":  (0.30, 0.15, 0.5),     # fraction of I1 supplied by resistor
    "vout0": (0.9, 0.7, 1.1),       # target output DC
    "gmidp": (10, 6, 14),           # PMOS mirror gm/Id
    "Lp":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),       # PMOS mirror L
    "Iref2": (20e-6, 8e-6, 40e-6),  # PMOS reference branch current
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 20e-6)
    I1, L1, fr, vo = p["I1"], p["L1"], p["frac"], p["vout0"]

    # M1: size W so that Id(vgs=VIN_DC) = I1 at vds = vout0
    o1 = lut.op("n", 1.0, L1, vin, vo)
    W1 = I1 / o1["Id"]
    m1 = lut.op("n", W1, L1, vin, vo)
    gm1, gds1 = m1["gm"], m1["gds"]

    # load split: resistor to VDD carries frac*I1, PMOS source the rest
    Ir = fr * I1
    Ip = I1 - Ir
    R = (vdd - vo) / Ir

    mp_ref = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], p["Iref2"], vds=None or 0.6)
    mp2 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Ip, vds=vdd - vo)
    # NMOS mirror of ibias -> sinks Iref2 from PMOS diode
    mn0 = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, iref, vds=0.6)
    mn0 = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, iref, vds=mn0.vgs)
    mn1 = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, p["Iref2"], vds=vdd - mp_ref.vgs)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MN0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mn0)
    n.dev("MN1", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mn1)
    n.dev("MP0", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp_ref)
    n.dev("MP2", "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp2)
    n.M("M1", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W1, L1)
    n.R("RL", "vdd", "vout", R)

    gtot = gds1 + mp2.gds + 1.0 / R
    A = gm1 / gtot
    cout = cl + mp2.cdd + 1.5e-15 * W1
    f3 = gtot / (2 * PI * cout)
    power = vdd * (I1 + iref + p["Iref2"])
    vdsat1 = max(m1.get("vdsat", 0.15), 0.1)
    swing = (vdd - mp2.vdsat - 0.05) - (vdsat1 + 0.05)
    return n, {"gain_db": db(A), "f3db": f3, "gbw": A * f3,
               "power": power, "vout_dc": vo, "swing": swing}
